title: Freightliner Argosy 381 Fups Bullbar #1
description: Heavy duty Freightliner Argosy FUPS high tensile aluminium bull bar with cow catcher style under-run bar with additional support between uprights, driving light mounts to specification supplied, heavy duty tow pin in heavy duty steel backing plate, one piece cross tubes, passing through drilled inner uprights, recessed into drilled outer uprights.
